title: Yn dooghys as ny imbaghyn
description: Ten short stories about nature and the seasons on the Isle of Man: butterflies and berries, the market and the sea, a summer storm, winter ice, the Arctic, an old battle site, spring words in a Manx class and a village flower show.

lessons.title: Yn foillycan
lessons.summary: In summer Peggy finds a caterpillar behind the house; it grows, hangs still and comes out as a butterfly, and she films its first flight to show her father.
lessons.text:
Ta Clara Fayle cummal ayns Doolish marish e inneen, Peggy. Ta'n tourey er çheet. Ta lus mooar cooyl y thie, as ta duillagyn glassey er.

Un laa, ta Peggy jeeaghyn er y lus. Ta red beg glass er duillag. “Cre ta shoh?” t'ee gra rish e moir.

Ta Clara jeeaghyn er. “She praddag t'ayn,” t'ee gra. “Ta'n praddag gee ny duillagyn. Tra vees eh mooar, bee eh ny foillycan.”

Ta Peggy jeeaghyn er y phraddag dagh laa. Ta'n praddag gee as gee, as t'eh mooadaghey dagh laa.

Eisht un laa, cha nel y praddag gee. T'eh croghey fo duillag, as t'eh dhone nish. “Vel eh marroo?” ta Peggy gra.

“Cha nel,” ta'n moir eck gra. “T'eh caghlaa. Jeeagh er dagh laa.”

Ec jerrey yn tourey, ta Peggy as e moir cooyl y thie. Ta'n laa gial, as ta'n grian soilshaghey. Ta'n red dhone foshlit, as ta foillycan çheet magh. Ta skianyn jiarg as doo echey, as t'ad gial 'sy ghrian.

Ta Peggy jannoo feeshan jeh'n foillycan. Ta'n foillycan soie er y duillag son tammylt. Eisht t'eh goll er etlagh. She yn chied etlagh echey, as t'eh giare: t'eh goll dys blaa jiarg faggys da'n thie.

“Cre t'eh jannoo nish?” ta Peggy gra.

“T'eh goaill bee veih'n vlaa,” ta Clara gra.

Lurg tammylt, ta foillycan elley çheet. Ta piyr dy 'oillycanyn er y vlaa nish. Ta Peggy jannoo feeshan jeh'n phiyr. Eisht ta'n piyr goll er etlagh reesht, seose harrish y thie.

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta Peggy soilshaghey yn feeshan da'n ayr eck. Ta'n ayr gearey. “She feeshan mie eh,” t'eh gra. “As she inneen vie oo.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel lus mooar cooyl y thie?
Ta. Ta lus mooar cooyl y thie, as ta duillagyn glassey er.
Vel y praddag mooadaghey?
Ta. Ta'n praddag gee as gee, as t'eh mooadaghey.
Row'n laa gial tra haink y foillycan magh?
Va. Va'n laa gial, as va'n grian soilshaghey.
Vel Peggy jannoo feeshan?
Ta. Ta Peggy jannoo feeshan jeh'n foillycan as jeh'n phiyr.

lessons.title: Berrishyn ny fouyir
lessons.summary: In autumn Arthur goes out with his red dog Rex to pick blackberries; the dog eats bad ones and runs off, and Arthur finds him under an old tree full of golden leaves.
lessons.text:
Ta'n fouyir er çheet. Ta ny duillagyn er ny biljyn airhey as jiarg, as ta'n grian injil 'sy speyr.

Ta Arthur Cannan cummal ayns thie shenn faggys da Rhumsaa. Ta moddey echey, Rex. She moddey mooar ruy eh, as ta fynney ruy liauyr er.

Un laa, ta Arthur goaill cappan mooar, as t'eh goll magh lesh Rex dy chruinnaghey berrishyn. Ta berrishyn doo gaase rish y raad, eddyr y thie as y cronk.

Ta dhossan mooar dy verrishyn er dagh lus. Ta ny berrishyn bog as mie. Ta Arthur cruinnaghey ad, dhossan lurg dhossan, as ta'n cappan lane dy leah.

Agh cha nel dy chooilley verrish mie. Ta paart jeu drogh: t'ad feer vog, as t'ad lheeah. “Cha lhisagh oo gee ny berrishyn drogh,” ta Arthur gra rish Rex. Agh ta Rex gee berrish ny ghaa.

Lurg tammylt, ta Arthur jeeaghyn mygeayrt. Cha nel Rex ayn!

“Ta mee er choayl y moddey!” t'eh gra. T'eh goll seose y raad as sheese y raad. “Rex! Rex!” Cha nel moddey ruy erbee ry-akin.

Ta Arthur goll seose er y cronk. Ayns shen, fo billey shenn, ta Rex ny lhie. Ta dhossan dy verrishyn ayns e veeal, as ta'n fynney ruy echey lane dy ghuillagyn airhey.

Ta Arthur gearey. “Cha lhisagh oo goll ersooyl,” t'eh gra. “Cha mie lhiam dty choayl.”

Ta Arthur as Rex goll thie. 'Sy thie, ta Arthur jannoo bee millish lesh ny berrishyn bog. Ta Rex ny lhie er y laare, as t'eh jeeaghyn er.

Feyshtyn:
Vel ny duillagyn airhey?
Ta. Ta ny duillagyn er ny biljyn airhey as jiarg.
Vel ny berrishyn ooilley mie?
Cha nel. Ta paart jeu drogh, as cha lhisagh Rex gee ad.
Ren Arthur coayl y moddey?
Ren. Ren eh coayl Rex, agh ren eh feddyn eh fo billey shenn.
Vel folt ruy er Rex?
Ta. She moddey mooar ruy eh.

lessons.title: Laa 'sy margey
lessons.summary: Farmer Harold sells his peas at the market in Ramsey; Sylvia buys some, trade is good, and at the end of the day he takes the money to the small bank in the town.
lessons.text:
She eirinagh eh Harold Quaye. Ta thalloo echey faggys da Rhumsaa. Ta lossreeyn gaase er y thalloo echey, as ta fynneigyn glassey orroo. Ta rassyn cruinn glassey ayns dagh fynneig.

Ta'n fouyir er çheet, as ta ny fynneigyn appee. Jiu, ta Harold goll dys y margey ayns Rhumsaa dy chreck ny fynneigyn echey.

Ta'n margey mooar, as ta mooarane sleih ayn. Ta eirinee elley ayn neesht. T'ad creck eeastyn, mess as bee elley. Ta sleih goll veih boayrd dys boayrd, as t'ad kionnaghey.

Ta ben, Sylvia, çheet dys boayrd Harold. “By vie lhiam kionnaghey fynneigyn,” t'ee gra.

“Ta rassyn cruinn ayns ny fynneigyn shoh,” ta Harold gra. “T'ad mie as millish.”

Ta Sylvia goaill fynneig, as t'ee gee rass. “T'ad millish!” t'ee gra. Ta Sylvia kionnaghey ram fynneigyn.

Ec mean y laa, ta Harold kionnaghey meer dy eeast veih fer elley 'sy margey. T'eh gee y meer eeast ec e voayrd.

Ta'n traght mie jiu. Ta sleih kionnaghey ram, as ta ny fynneigyn ooilley creckit. “Tra ta'n traght mie, ta argid ec ny eirinee,” ta Harold gra. “Tra ta'n traght drogh, cha nel.”

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta Harold goll dys y banc lesh yn argid. She ynnyd argidoil eh Doolish, as ta ram bancyn ayns shen. Agh ta banc beg ayns Rhumsaa neesht, as cha nel Harold goll dys Doolish agh son cooishyn argidoil mooarey.

Ta'n ben ayns y banc gearey. “Ren oo creck ooilley ny fynneigyn?” t'ee gra.

“Ren,” ta Harold gra. “Agh ta meer dy eeast aym foast!”

Feyshtyn:
Vel rassyn cruinn ayns ny fynneigyn?
Ta. Ta rassyn cruinn glassey ayns dagh fynneig.
Ren Sylvia kionnaghey fynneigyn?
Ren. Ren Sylvia kionnaghey ram fynneigyn veih Harold.
Row'n traght mie?
Va. Va'n traght mie, as va ny fynneigyn ooilley creckit.
Vel banc ayns Rhumsaa?
Ta. Ta banc beg ayns Rhumsaa, as ta ram bancyn ayns Doolish.

lessons.title: Yn çhenney
lessons.summary: On a hot, dry summer day Eric and his sister Martha see lightning strike an old tree; a fire starts in the dry plants, the power goes off, and heavy rain puts the fire out.
lessons.text:
Ta Eric Lewney as e huyr Martha cummal er thalloo ayns twoaie yn ellan. Ta billey feer shenn faggys da'n thie oc.

Ta'n tourey feer çheh. Cha row fliaghey ayn rish mee. Ta'n thalloo çhirrym, as ta ny lossreeyn çhirrym as buigh.

Ta lectraghys y thie gientit liorish y ghrian. Er mullagh y thie, ta reddyn gorrym ta jannoo lectraghys veih soilshey ny greiney. 'Sy tourey, ta mooarane lectraghys gientit ayn. Ta gleashtan lectragh ec Martha neesht.

Un laa çheh, ta'n speyr caghlaa. Ta bodjallyn doo çheet veih'n sheear, as ta'n geay lajer. Eisht ta çhenney ayns y speyr. Ta Eric as Martha jeeaghyn magh trooid yn uinnag.

Ta çhenney elley çheet, as t'eh bwoalley yn billey shenn. Ta'n billey brisht, as ta aile ayns ny lossreeyn çhirrym fo.

“Ta gaue ayn!” ta Martha gra. “Bee yn aile çheet dys y thie!”

Ta Eric goll magh lesh ushtey. Ta'n aile çheh, as ta'n jaagh doo. Ta Martha gra rish: “Tar erash! Ta gaue ayn!” Ta Eric çheet erash dys y thie.

Cha nel lectraghys ayns y thie nish. Cha nel soilshey ayn, as cha nod Martha cur lectraghys ayns y gleashtan lectragh eck.

Eisht ta'n fliaghey çheet. Ta'n fliaghey trome, as t'eh tuittym er yn aile. Lurg tammylt, cha nel yn aile ayn.

Tra ta'n fliaghey er scuirr, ta Eric as Martha goll magh. Ta'n billey shenn scryssit. Ren y çhenney scryssey eh.

“Va'n billey shoh ayn rish tree cheead blein,” ta Martha gra.

“Agh ta'n thie ain mie,” ta Eric gra. Ta'n lectraghys çheet erash ec jerrey yn laa.

Feyshtyn:
Vel y tourey çheh as çhirrym?
Ta. Ta'n tourey feer çheh, as ta'n thalloo çhirrym.
Ren y çhenney bwoalley yn billey?
Ren. Ren y çhenney bwoalley yn billey shenn, as va aile ayn.
Row lectraghys ayns y thie?
Cha row. Cha row lectraghys ayns y thie, as cha row soilshey ayn.
Vel y billey scryssit?
Ta. Ta'n billey shenn scryssit.

lessons.title: Er y faarkey
lessons.summary: Rachel works on a fishing boat from Peel; Captain Felix takes the crew five kilometres out through a narrow sound, they bring the fish back, and Rachel salts them.
lessons.text:
Ta Rachel Kegg obbraghey er baatey eeastee ayns Pheeil. She Felix Cleator y captan. Ta skimmee y vaatey jeant seose jeh kiare peiagh: Felix, Rachel as daa ghooinney elley.

Roish keead blein, va lhuingys mooar eeastee ayns Pheeil, as va ram baatyn ayn. Nish cha nel agh lhuingys beg ayn.

Ec toshiaght y laa ayns Averil, ta'n baatey goll magh er y faarkey. Ta'n faarkey lhean as gorrym, as ta'n aer feayr. Ta'n geay cur ushtey sailley er eddin Rachel.

Ta'n captan goaill y baatey trooid keyllys. Ta'n keyllys eddyr Ellan Vannin as ellan veg. T'eh un kilomeader er lheead, as ta'n ushtey ayn tappee.

“Ta gaue ayns y keyllys shoh,” ta Felix gra rish y skimmee. “Ta creggyn fo'n ushtey.”

Lurg y keyllys, ta'n baatey goll queig kilomeader magh. Ayns shen, ta'n faarkey lhean as feayn. Ta'n skimmee goaill ram eeastyn.

“She laa mie eh!” ta'n captan gra.

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta'n baatey çheet erash dys Pheeil. T'eh gymmyrkey ny eeastyn dys y phurt. Eisht ta'n skimmee gymmyrkey ny eeastyn dys y margey.

Ta Rachel goaill paart jeh ny eeastyn thie. T'ee cur sollan orroo, son dy vel ny eeastyn mie rish tammylt liauyr lesh sollan.

“Ta sollan ayns y faarkey, as sollan er ny eeastyn,” t'ee gra, as t'ee gearey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Felix ny chaptan er y baatey?
Ta. She Felix Cleator y captan.
Row lhuingys mooar ayns Pheeil roish keead blein?
Va. Va lhuingys mooar eeastee ayn, as va ram baatyn ayn.
Vel y keyllys lhean?
Cha nel. T'eh un kilomeader er lheead.
Vel Rachel cur sollan er ny eeastyn?
Ta. T'ee cur sollan er ny eeastyn ec y thie.

lessons.title: Rio er y logh
lessons.summary: On a winter day teacher Helen explains to her pupils why winter is cold, then takes them to the frozen lake to show them ice, water and the oxygen and hydrogen they are made of.
lessons.text:
She ynseyder ayns bunscoill ayns Doolish ee Helen Kinnin. Ta'n geurey er çheet, as ta brat rio er y logh faggys da'n scoill.

Un laa, ta guilley, Bernard, gra rish yn ynseyder: “Cre'n fa ta'n geurey feayr?”

Ta Helen gra: “Ta'n Dowan cruinlaghey mygeayrt y Ghrian. Ta'n cruinlagh echey goaill un vlein. Agh cha nel y Dowan shassoo jeeragh. Ayns ayrn jeh'n cruinlagh, ta'n twoaie jeeaghyn ersooyl veih'n ghrian, as ta'n soilshey ny sloo. Shen yn geurey ain. Ayns ayrn elley jeh'n cruinlagh, ta'n twoaie jeeaghyn gys y ghrian. Shen yn tourey.”

Eisht ta'n ynseyder goaill ny paitçhyn magh dys y logh. Ta brat rio er yn ushtey.

“Ta'n rio creoi,” ta Helen gra. “Agh fo'n brat rio, ta'n ushtey foast ny ushlagh.”

“Vod shin goll er y rio?” ta Bernard gra.

“Cha nod,” ta'n ynseyder gra. “Cha nel y brat lajer dy liooar. Ta gaue ayn.”

Ta Helen goaill meer dy rio creoi ayns e laue. “Ta ushtey jeant jeh hiddragien as ocsygien,” t'ee gra. “Tra ta'n ushtey feer feayr, t'eh caghlaa dys rio creoi. Tra ta'n rio çheh reesht, t'eh caghlaa erash dys ushlagh. She caghlaa corpagh eh shoh: cha nel y stoo caghlaa. Ta'n hiddragien as yn ocsygien ayn foast.”

“As vel ocsygien 'syn aer?” ta Bernard gra.

“Ta,” ta Helen gra. “Ta shin goaill ocsygien stiagh dagh traa.”

Ta ny paitçhyn goll erash dys y scoill. Ta'n meer dy rio ayns laue Helen ny ushlagh nish.

“Vel caghlaa corpagh ayn tra ta'n sniaghtey lheie?” ta Bernard gra.

“Ta,” ta Helen gra. “She caghlaa corpagh eh shen neesht.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel y Dowan cruinlaghey mygeayrt y Ghrian?
Ta. Ta'n Dowan cruinlaghey mygeayrt y Ghrian, as ta'n cruinlagh goaill un vlein.
Vel brat rio er y logh?
Ta. Ta brat rio er y logh, agh cha nel eh lajer dy liooar.
Vel ushtey jeant jeh hiddragien as ocsygien?
Ta. Ta ushtey jeant jeh hiddragien as ocsygien.

lessons.title: Yn ronseyder
lessons.summary: Professor Philip, who is also an explorer, speaks on a stage in Ramsey about his journey to the Arctic: a small plane, strong winds, a traveller with bad health, and a book coming out next year.
lessons.text:
She olloo ec ollooscoill ayns Nalbin eh Philip Mylroie. Agh t'eh ny ronseyder neesht. Va Philip ruggit ayns Rhumsaa, as jiu t'eh çheet erash.

Ta mooarane sleih ayns thie mooar 'sy valley. Ta'n olloo shassoo er yn ardan, as t'eh loayrt mychione y twoaie arctagh.

“Hie mee lesh etlan dys y twoaie,” t'eh gra. “Va'n etlan beg, as v'eh craa 'sy gheay. Va shey troailtee ayn marym.”

“'Sy twoaie arctagh, cha nel biljyn erbee. Ta sniaghtey as rio er dy chooilley red. 'Sy tourey, ta'n grian 'sy speyr son yn oie ooilley.”

Ta guilley aeg gra: “Row'n geay lajer?”

“Va,” ta'n ronseyder gra. “Va bieauid y gheay keead kilomeader 'syn oor. Ec y vieauid shen, cha nod oo shassoo.”

“Ta slaynt vie feme er ronseyder 'sy twoaie arctagh. Va slaynt drogh ec fer jeh ny troailtee, as hie eh thie lesh etlan. Va'n troailtagh elley mie.”

Ta Philip soilshaghey jallooyn da ny sleih. Ta jalloo ayn jeh moddey bane 'sy sniaghtey, as jalloo elley jeh'n etlan beg.

“Ta mee er screeu lioar mychione y turrys,” t'eh gra. “Nee soilsheyder ayns Doolish soilshaghey yn lioar 'sy vlein noa. She soilsheyder beg eh, agh t'eh mie.”

Ec jerrey yn oie, ta'n olloo faagail yn ardan. Ta ben shenn gra rish: “By vie lhiam goll dys y twoaie arctagh!”

“Bare dhyt goll 'sy tourey,” ta'n ronseyder gra, as t'eh gearey.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Philip ny olloo?
Ta. She olloo eh, as t'eh ny ronseyder neesht.
Row bieauid y gheay mooar?
Va. Va bieauid y gheay keead kilomeader 'syn oor.
Row slaynt vie ec ny troailtee ooilley?
Cha row. Va slaynt drogh ec fer jeh ny troailtee.
Nee soilsheyder soilshaghey yn lioar?
Nee. Nee soilsheyder ayns Doolish soilshaghey yn lioar.

lessons.title: Laaragh y chah
lessons.summary: On a cold winter day Frank takes his grandson Alan to the bend of a river where an earl and a knight once fought; he tells how the knight won and how the queen gave him the land.
lessons.text:
Ta Frank Halsall as Alan, mac e vac, goll magh er laa feayr 'sy geurey. Ta sniaghtey er y slieau, as ta'n aer feayr.

Ta awin roie trooid y glion, as ta lhoob mooar 'syn awin. Ec y lhoob, ta magher lhean.

“She laaragh cah shenn eh shoh,” ta Frank gra. “Roish shey cheead blein, va cah ayns shoh.”

“Row ree 'sy chah?” ta Alan gra.

“Cha row,” ta Frank gra. “Va eearley as reejerey ayn. Va caggey eddyr yn eearley as y reejerey son y thalloo shoh. Haink yn eearley lesh keead sidoor er cabbil. Va cabbyl mooar doo echey hene.”

“As y reejerey?”

“Cha row agh beggan sidooryn ec y reejerey, agh v'eh ny sidoor mie. Scugh y reejerey e hidooryn dys y lhoob 'syn awin. Va'n awin er dagh çheu jeu. Cha row ny cabbil abyl goll trooid yn ushtey dowin, as ren y reejerey cosney yn cah.”

“As cre haink er yn eearley?”

“Hie yn eearley erash dys e chashtal. Lurg y cah, hug y venrein y thalloo da'n reejerey. Va'n venrein reill harrish y çheer ooilley ec y traa shen.”

Ta Alan jeeaghyn er y magher. “Cha nel yn awin ec y laaragh nish,” t'eh gra.

“Cha nel,” ta Frank gra. “Ta awinyn scughey rish ny bleeantyn. Roish shey cheead blein, va'n lhoob ny sodjey sheear. Ta'n lhoob er scughey.”

“She eiraght ain eh y laaragh shoh,” ta Frank gra. “Ta eiraght mooar ayns ny magheryn as ny sleityn shoh.”

Ta'n grian goll sheese, as t'ad goll thie.

Feyshtyn:
Vel lhoob mooar 'syn awin?
Ta. Ta lhoob mooar 'syn awin, as ta magher lhean ec y lhoob.
Row cabbyl ec yn eearley?
Va. Va cabbyl mooar doo ec yn eearley.
Ren y reejerey cosney yn cah?
Ren. Ren y reejerey cosney yn cah ec y lhoob.
Hug y venrein y thalloo da'n reejerey?
Hug. Hug y venrein y thalloo da'n reejerey lurg y cah.

lessons.title: Grammeydys ayns Averil
lessons.summary: In April Ivan's evening class of adult Manx learners writes sentences about spring flowers; Gethin, who speaks Welsh, and Lena, who speaks German, learn about nouns, subjects, agreement and formal speech.
lessons.text:
She ynseyder Gaelg eh Ivan Quark. Ta possan beg dy leih aasit ynsaghey Gaelg marish. Mee Averil t'ayn, as ta blaaghyn buigh er ny sleityn.

Ta daa studeyr noa ayns y possan. Ta Gethin çheet ass Bretyn, as ta Bretnish echey. Ta Lena cummal ayns Doolish nish, agh she Germaanish y çhengey eck. Ta Lena jannoo studeyrys çhengagh ec ollooscoill.

Jiu, ta Ivan ynsaghey grammeydys. T'eh screeu raa er y voayrd: “Ta'n blaa buigh.”

“Jeeagh er 'blaa',” t'eh gra. “She ennymockle eh. As ayns y raa shoh, she yn jantagh eh. Ta'n jantagh çheet lurg y vreear ayns Gaelg.”

“Ayns Bretnish, ta'n jantagh çheet lurg y vreear neesht,” ta Gethin gra.

“Cha nel ayns Germaanish,” ta Lena gra.

Eisht ta Ivan gra: “Ayns Gaelg, ta coardailys eddyr yn ennymockle as y fockle ta çheet lurg eh. Ta shin gra 'ben vie', agh 'dooinney mie'.”

“Ta coardailys ayns Germaanish neesht,” ta Lena gra. “As ta grammeydys Germaanish doillee!”

“Ta grammeydys dy chooilley hengey doillee,” ta Ivan gra, as t'eh gearey.

Eisht t'eh gra: “Ta 'shiu' formoil, as ta 'oo' neuformoil. Ta shin gra 'shiu' rish ynseyder ny rish sleih noa. Lena, vel 'Kys t'ou?' formoil ny dyn?”

“Cha nel,” ta Lena gra. “Cha nel eh formoil.”

“Kiart!” ta Ivan gra. “As Gethin, vel 'Arragh' ny ennymockle ny dyn?”

“Ta,” ta Gethin gra. “She ennymockle eh.”

Ec jerrey y laa, ta Lena gra: “She cooish çhengagh aitt eh grammeydys.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Bretnish ec Gethin?
Ta. Ta Gethin çheet ass Bretyn, as ta Bretnish echey.
Vel 'blaa' ny ennymockle?
Ta. She ennymockle eh, as she yn jantagh eh ayns y raa.
Vel coardailys ayns Germaanish?
Ta. Ta coardailys ayns Germaanish neesht.
Vel 'shiu' formoil?
Ta. Ta 'shiu' formoil, as ta 'oo' neuformoil.

lessons.title: Feaill ny blaaghyn
lessons.summary: At the end of summer vandals break the tables of the village flower show; the committee and the villagers clean up, and the committee's judgment gives first place to Agnes's little tree shaped like a horse.
lessons.text:
Ec jerrey Luanistyn, ta feaill ny blaaghyn ayns y valley. Ta bing ec y valley, as ta'n ving reaghey yn feaill dagh blein. She Rufus fer-toshee y ving.

Ta Agnes Quinney gaase blaaghyn as biljyn beggey ec y thie eck. 'Sy tourey, va gorley er ny blaaghyn eck. Va ny duillagyn dhone, as va aggle urree. Agh ren ee glenney ny lossreeyn, as nish ta'n gorley ersooyl.

Ta billey beg ec Agnes ta cummit myr cabbyl. Ta billey elley eck ta cummit myr moddey. “Bee y cabbyl ayns y feaill,” t'ee gra.

'Syn oie roish yn feaill, ta cragheyderyn çheet stiagh 'sy vagher. T'ad brishey ny buird, as t'ad ceau blaaghyn er y thalloo.

'Sy voghrey, ta Rufus çheet. “Quoi ren shoh?” t'eh gra. Cha nel fys ec peiagh erbee quoi va ny cragheyderyn.

Ta'n bing as sleih y valley glenney yn magher. T'ad troggal ny buird reesht, as t'ad glenney ny blaaghyn. Lurg daa oor, ta'n magher glen.

Ec mean y laa, ta'n feaill toshiaght. Ta'n bing jeeaghyn er ny blaaghyn as ny biljyn. Eisht ta Rufus gra: “Ta briwnys ain. She cabbyl Agnes yn fer share!”

Ta Agnes gearey. “Quoi ren yn cabbyl shoh?” ta ben aeg gra.

“Ren mish,” ta Agnes gra. “Va gorley er ny duillagyn 'sy tourey, agh nish t'eh glen as mie.”

“She briwnys mie eh,” ta sleih y valley gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel bing ec y valley?
Ta. Ta bing ec y valley, as t'ee reaghey yn feaill.
Row gorley er ny blaaghyn ec Agnes?
Va. Va gorley er ny blaaghyn eck 'sy tourey.
Quoi ren brishey ny buird?
Cragheyderyn. Cha nel fys ec peiagh erbee quoi v'ad.
Vel billey Agnes cummit myr cabbyl?
Ta. Ta'n billey beg eck cummit myr cabbyl.
